podcast.body: This "metallic love song" by the L.A. band Ratt reached number 12 on the charts in 1984. Its success contributed to their LP "Out of the Cellar" going top 10 and double platinum, exemplifying how "shamelessly catchy" metal could be during that year. "L.A. band Ratt, with their metallic love song Round and Round. The single reached number 12 and their LP Out of the Cellar went top 10 and double platinum."
